description: GCompris is open showing the Reading/Alphabet category (Letters tab). Find and click the 'Alphabet sequence' activity tile (shows a yellow helicopter over a desert landscape with a small letter tile). In this activity, a letter appears floating in the sky and also shown in a tile at the bottom-right corner — you must press that letter on the keyboard. Each correct keypress makes the letter fly to the helicopter and the next letter in alphabetical sequence appears. Starting from 'a', type the letters in alphabetical order (a, b, c, d, e, ...) by pressing each key as it appears. Type at least 5 letters in sequence (a through e) to complete the task.
